description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeService component in the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for various methods of the EmployeeService class, including retrieval of associated services and DAOs, subordinate/supervisor ID lookups, and email uniqueness checks.

classes.name: EmployeeServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the EmployeeService class functions within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of EmployeeService before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDao
methods.description: Verifies that getEmployeeDao() returns an instance of EmployeeDao.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEventService
methods.description: Checks that getEmployeeEventService() returns an instance of EmployeeEventService.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeTerminationService
methods.description: Checks that getEmployeeTerminationService() returns an instance of EmployeeTerminationService.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId
methods.description: Tests the behavior of getSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId() method with different includeChain parameters.

methods.name: testIsSupervisor
methods.description: Asserts that isSupervisor() correctly identifies an employee as a supervisor.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployees
methods.description: Verifies deleteEmployees() deletes provided employee IDs and returns the count.

methods.name: testGetSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId
methods.description: Tests getSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId() method with various includeChain parameters.

methods.name: testIsUniqueEmail
methods.description: Tests whether isUniqueEmail() correctly determines email uniqueness based on fixture data.
